name: Quantum Portfolio Optimization Benchmark
description: Finance-specific benchmark evaluating quantum optimization algorithms for Markowitz mean-variance portfolio selection. Compares QAOA, VQE, and quantum annealing against classical solvers (MIP, meta-heuristics) on asset selection and allocation problems. Recent studies highlight that while quantum methods minimize cost functions effectively, resulting portfolios may violate practical financial constraints.

sources.title: Quantum Portfolio Optimization: An Extensive Benchmark
